questions.title: URL Shortener Service
questions.description: Design a URL shortening service that maps long URLs to compact short codes. Support high read traffic for redirects with low latency and durable storage. Many URL shorteners use Base62-encoded identifiers for compact short codes.
requirements: Handle 500 requests per second for primary operations
Maintain p95 latency under 300ms for read operations
Keep error rate under 2.0% during normal load
Eliminate single points of failure via redundancy in critical components
Store data durably with at least 2 replicas across failure domains
Support at least 10 million unique shortened URLs with constant-time lookup
expectedPatterns: URL Shortener Service uses caching for short-code to URL mappings
URL Shortener Service horizontally scales app servers for redirect traffic
URL Shortener Service uses async_processing for click analytics aggregation
idealSolutionCharacteristics: Stores short-code to URL mappings in a replicated database with read-optimized schema
Places a cache in front of the database to serve most redirect lookups
Uses a load balancer in front of multiple app servers to handle redirect traffic
Sends click and analytics events asynchronously to a queue processed by workers
